faqs.q: Where is Alaya Resort Corbett located?

faqs.q: Which room is best for families at Alaya Resort Corbett?
faqs.a: The Attic Room is a good option for a small family, offering around 58 sq m of space with a king-size bed and an additional sleeping area reached by a few steps within the room. For larger families, the resort also offers Family Rooms with a separate living area, providing additional space for a comfortable stay.

faqs.q: Is Alaya Resort Corbett good for families with kids?

faqs.q: What activities can guests enjoy at Alaya Resort Corbett?
faqs.a: Apart from relaxing at the resort, guests can enjoy activities such as birdwatching, indoor games, cricket, badminton and other outdoor recreation. Birdwatching is particularly associated with the property in guest reviews, making Alaya an interesting choice for travellers who enjoy nature and wildlife beyond the jungle safari.

faqs.q: Does Alaya Resort Corbett have a swimming pool and restaurant?
faqs.a: Yes. Alaya Resort Corbett has an outdoor swimming pool and an in-house restaurant, along with Wi-Fi, parking and recreational facilities. Google guest feedback also frequently highlights the resort's restaurant and breakfast buffet.

faqs.q: Is Alaya Resort Corbett a good choice for a peaceful nature stay?
faqs.a: Yes. Alaya Resort Corbett is located in the Kyari area, surrounded by greenery and a quieter natural setting away from the more crowded tourist stretches of Corbett. Its open spaces, birdwatching opportunities and relaxed surroundings make it suitable for couples and families looking to combine a peaceful resort stay with their Jim Corbett holiday.

faqs.q: What is the price of Alaya Resort Corbett?
faqs.a: Room rates at Alaya Resort Corbett start from around ₹5,499 per night with breakfast for two guests. Prices vary depending on the room category, meal plan, travel dates and season. Premium, Attic and Family categories are generally priced higher, while rates may increase during weekends, long weekends and festive periods.

reviews.text: We were a group of seven couples from Nepal on a relaxing holiday. We flew from Kathmandu to Dhangadhi and then traveled by road in four SUVs, crossing into India through the Gadda Chauki (Mahendranagar, Nepal) – Banbasa (Uttarakhand, India) border. After about a 4½-hour drive, we reached Bhimtal and stayed at Hotel Harshikhar for two nights. Choosing Hotel Harshikhar turned out to be one of the best decisions of our trip. The hotel offers a warm, homely atmosphere that makes you feel comfortable from the moment you arrive. It is an excellent choice for families, though couples and solo travelers will also enjoy their stay. What makes it even better is that it is very budget-friendly, offering excellent value for money without compromising on comfort or service. The staff are exceptionally courteous, attentive, and well-trained. The service is impressively quick, and their hospitality truly stands out. One thing that particularly impressed us was the restaurant service. Even if you are dining alone, a staff member is always attentive and ready to assist without being intrusive. It reflects the hotel’s commitment to guest satisfaction. The food was delicious, freshly prepared, and served promptly. Every meal we had was enjoyable. Our rooms were spacious, clean, and comfortable. While they are not luxury five-star rooms, they have everything needed for a pleasant and relaxing stay. The hotel is centrally located in Bhimtal, making it convenient to visit the lake and nearby temple. During our stay, I genuinely could not find any shortcomings worth mentioning. Everything—from cleanliness to hospitality and overall management—was excellent. As for Bhimtal itself, it is a peaceful destination. However, if someone is planning a sightseeing holiday in this region, I would personally recommend Nainital over Bhimtal. Nainital offers more attractions, a livelier atmosphere, and, because of its higher altitude, generally more pleasant weather. The room is comfortable and the mango trees on the resort provide the lush green cover to its terrain. Food is superb and all included- breakfast, lunch, high tea and dinner. faqs.q: Which room is better at Serenity Corbett – Super Deluxe or Family Attic?

The Family Attic Room is on the first floor and includes a king-size bed plus an attic-style extra sleeping space for kids, along with a private balcony and natural views.

faqs.q: Is Serenity Corbett Resort a good choice for families with children?

The resort also offers indoor games such as table tennis, carrom and pool, along with outdoor activities including badminton, cricket and football.

faqs.q: Does Serenity Corbett Resort have rooms suitable for a family of four?

faqs.q: What dining options are available at Serenity Corbett Resort?

Guests can choose suitable meal plans with their stay, making it convenient for couples and families who prefer dining within the resort during their Jim Corbett holiday.

reviews.text: We spent 4 wonderful days at Chamomile Estate, Guniyalekh, and it was exactly the break our family needed. If you're travelling with kids, this place is a gem. The rooms are comfortable, the views are spectacular, and surprisingly, the network connectivity is quite good too. The food deserves a special mention—absolutely finger-licking delicious! Every meal felt homely and made with care. The staff were extremely courteous, knowledgeable, and genuinely kind. You can clearly see the effort the owners have put into creating an experience rather than just a stay. The highlights for us were relaxing in the jacuzzi, watching a movie on the outdoor projector under the stars, and witnessing one of the most beautiful night skies we've ever seen. We even spotted a shooting star for the first time and could make out the Milky Way—something truly magical. Located a couple of hours away from the crowds and commercialization of Nainital, Chamomile Estate offers peace, fresh air, and serenity that's becoming increasingly rare. The only traffic here seems to be birds, clouds, and excited kids running around! A perfect getaway for families, nature lovers, and anyone looking to disconnect from noise and reconnect with simple joys. We left with happy memories, full stomachs, and a promise to return. Highly recommended!

faqs.q: Which is the best room category to book at Tiaraa Corbett?
faqs.a: Tiaraa Corbett offers multiple room categories for different stay preferences. Deluxe Rooms are ideal for couples looking for a comfortable stay, while Super Deluxe and Club Rooms provide more space. Club Rooms overlook the mango orchard, while Club Royal Deluxe Rooms feature a bathtub and garden view, making them a good choice for guests looking for a more premium experience.

faqs.q: Is Tiaraa Corbett a good resort for families with kids?
faqs.a: Yes. Tiaraa Corbett is particularly suitable for family holidays because of its spacious property, swimming pool, open lawns and dedicated Kids Zone with multiple games. With 94 rooms and several room categories, it also works well for larger families and groups travelling together.

faqs.q: What is special about the Jannat mango orchard at Tiaraa Corbett?
faqs.a: Jannat is the mango orchard inside Tiaraa Corbett and is one of the property's distinctive outdoor spaces. Guests looking for a quieter resort experience can spend time around the orchard, and the Club Room category offers views towards the mango orchard.

faqs.q: Does Tiaraa Corbett have a swimming pool and spa?
faqs.a: Yes. Tiaraa Corbett features a swimming pool as well as its Royal Spa. The resort also offers fine dining, indoor games, Wi-Fi, parking and concierge services, making it suitable for travellers who want resort facilities alongside their Jim Corbett holiday.

faqs.q: Is Tiaraa Corbett suitable for a destination wedding or large family function?
faqs.a: Yes. Tiaraa Corbett is designed to accommodate weddings and large celebrations, with a banquet hall, outdoor lawns and poolside event spaces. Its large room inventory is an additional advantage when accommodation is required for wedding or event guests at the same property.

faqs.q: Can I combine a stay at Tiaraa Corbett with a Jim Corbett jungle safari?
faqs.a: Yes. Tiaraa Corbett is located in Ramnagar, making it convenient to combine a luxury resort stay with a Jim Corbett jungle safari. Safari entry depends on the zone allotted and permit availability, so travellers should plan their safari booking in advance, particularly during busy weekends and peak season.

faqs.q: What is the price of Tiaraa Corbett?
faqs.a: Tiaraa Corbett stay packages currently start from around ₹4,799 per night with breakfast, while prices differ according to room category, meal plan, travel dates and season. Premium categories such as Club, Club Royal and Club Royal Deluxe are priced higher than the entry-level rooms.
